title: Research note (no κ): #2435's entrance raise is a width exchange paid by 72 partner splits; further raises saturate at ≈ +3e-7 (split-free raises worth up to +4.3e-6)
body:
**Research note (structural pricing screen); no κ claim.** [#2435](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2435) (Jeremy Kothe) gains +1.3164e-6 by raising 24 copy-buffer entrance frames per word from dimension 1 to 2. The change is frame-only (#2446). This note decomposes it per register and prices further raises of the same structural kind.

1. **It is a width exchange paid for by the partners.** In both providers, 96 registers' climbs change.
   - **The 24 raised helpers** each go from a rank-3 child to rank 2, and from width 8 to 7.
   - **72 gate partners** (6 X registers, 66 helpers) each split a rank-3 child into rank 2 + rank 1, which is locally worse.
   - The net gain is mainly packing: width-7 helpers fill the rank-16 bins as [7, 9].
2. **Calibration.** The width-aware bin-pattern LP (#2387/#2360/#1129) moves the ceiling by **+1.3166e-6** from #2322 to #2435. The realized κ gain is +1.3164e-6.
3. **Further raises at #2435's point** (k raises, each width 8 → 7):

| k | average #2435 pattern, partners included | own climb only, no partner splits |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | +3.05e-8 | +3.84e-7 |
| 10 | **+3.05e-7 (peak)** | +3.85e-6 |
| 12 | +9.6e-8 | **+4.35e-6 (peak)** |
| 16 | −1.40e-6 | +4.26e-6 |
| 26 | −6.02e-6 | +3.15e-6 |

   - With average partner costs the lever saturates after about 10 more raises, at about +3e-7, and then packing turns it negative.
   - Partner splits consume about 92% of each raise's value. Raises without partner splits are about 12× more valuable.
4. **Census of remaining sites.**
   - 112 dimension-1 entrances remain. Their (width, first climb) shapes are {(7,2): 30, (8,2): 26, (8,3): 52, (8,4): 4}, so 26 share the shape of #2435's 24.
   - Every one of them has its first gate at the entrance frame, and only 16 have those gates in A alone. Further raises therefore need a joint frame re-solve that treats entrances as variables.

**Checks.**
- The recounts of the four pinned words equal their reports, and the decomposition agrees across providers.
- The LP calibration reproduces the realized gain within 0.1%.
- `--check-only`, the 3.10 grammar check and the research tests pass. Run on CPython 3.14.4; the registered 3.12 replay was not run.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/t74-entrance-raise-prices/entrance_raise.py --fetch   # ~25 s
# PASS_T74_ENTRANCE_RAISE lp_gain=1.3166e-06 realized=1.3164e-06 best_further=+3.051e-07@k=10 own_only_k1=+3.839e-07 no_new_kappa
```

**Scope.** These are LP-ceiling prices. The average ladder assumes #2435's average partner cost. No raise is constructed; entrance delivery and Lemma A wrappers remain the open obligation, as in #2446. Base: main `0fdd7d82`. Assignment: structural-decoder track, seed 41; card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, scope changed.
